description: Health Canada says the Public Health Agency of Canada is not currently investigating any salmonella infections tied to a jalapeno-linked outbreak in the United States, where at least 345 people across 27 states have gotten sick.
title: Jalapeno-linked salmonella outbreak hits 27 U.S. states. What's the risk in Canada?

description: A New Mexico court has ordered Instagram and Facebook parent company Meta to pay $567 million US to address harms to young people from its platforms in the second phase of a landmark trial.
title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567M to address platforms' harms to young people

description: A detective who interviewed the man accused of starting one of the wildfires in the Spokane, Wash., area, said the man confessed, described his planning process and explained how he created a device to ignite the blaze.
title: Detective says man accused of starting Spokane wildfire confessed, described his planning process

description: Scientists have finally proven what Charles Darwin suspected more than a century ago — that a small, innocent-looking flowering plant growing in the rocky mountain crevices of southwestern China is, in fact, a killer.
title: Charles Darwin finally proven right about bug-eating plant after 150 years

description: U.S. President Donald Trump signed two executive orders on Thursday in a new but narrower attempt to curtail birthright citizenship, renewing his challenge to a provision of the U.S. Constitution after the U.S. Supreme Court rejected his previous effort.
title: Trump targets birthright citizenship with newly signed executive orders

description: Grab your coziest sweater, pour yourself a jumbo-sized mug of coffee and settle in, Gilmore Girls fans, because we’re headed back to Stars Hollow. HBO Max has announced a Gilmore Girls documentary is in production, promising never-before-seen footage and behind-the-scenes scoops from the people who brought the beloved Y2K comfort classic to life.
title: Grab your coffee: An official Gilmore Girls documentary is on the way

description: Reversing an earlier refusal, the FDA has approved Moderna's first mRNA flu shot for adults 50 and older. Here's what the major decision means as Health Canada considers its own approval of the vaccine.
title: U.S. FDA approves first mRNA flu shot from Moderna

description: The federal government has written to the UN to say it remains "deeply concerned" about the threats facing B.C.-based Sikh activist Moninder Singh and is taking action to disrupt all credible threats made by by foreign actors against those on Canadian soil.
title: Canada tells UN it's 'taking robust action' to disrupt threats against Sikh activist

description: Search and rescue commander Paul Berry says teams are currently working to extricate Keshav Jindal from steep terrain.
title: Missing hiker found in Strathcona Park on Vancouver Island

description: Arrests have been made related to the shooting at Toronto's Salsa on St. Clair festival last month, Toronto police Chief Myron Demkiw told reporters Thursday.
title: Arrests made for fatal Salsa on St. Clair festival shooting: Toronto police chief
Canada has 'nasty leadership,' says Trump as he praises U.S. tariff policy

description: Kelly Hrudey said Wednesday that he was told in June that his contract with Rogers Sportsnet would not be renewed for next season. He has appeared on Hockey Night in Canada on a full-time basis since 1998, immediately after his retirement as an NHL player.
title: Kelly Hrudey says he won't be back on Hockey Night in Canada as contract expires

description: Generations have passed since James O'Neill first walked from Canada to the U.S. via the Ambassador Bridge. Now the 93-year-old lifelong Windsor resident can say he's done it again — on the Gordie Howe International Bridge.
title: 93-year-old Windsor man fulfills dream of walking Gordie Howe bridge

description: Canada-U.S. Trade Minister Dominic LeBlanc and Canada's chief trade negotiator Janice Charette will be meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump's top trade envoy in Washington on Thursday.
title: Canadian, U.S. top trade officials meeting today in Washington

description: Olympic gold medalist and two-time world champion Lara Gut-Behrami announced her retirement from alpine skiing on Thursday.
title: Swiss ski great Lara Gut-Behrami retires after Olympic gold and world titles

description: Toronto police investigators are holding a news conference Thursday to provide an update on a gunshot being fired at the U.S. consulate last week. It was the second time the downtown building was the target of gunfire this year.
title: Toronto police to reveal new information about gunshot fired at U.S. consulate

description: Dr. Anthony Fauci on Thursday was held in contempt of Congress by a Republican-led Senate committee, just over a week after the longtime federal health official invoked the Fifth Amendment, declining to answer questions about his guidance during the COVID-19 pandemic.
title: U.S. Senate committee votes to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt

description: A South Korean satellite has captured images of the mark left on the moon when a SpaceX rocket crashed into it on Wednesday.
title: Here's the mark a SpaceX rocket crash left on the moon

description: The union representing WestJet cabin crew has shared details of the tentative deal reached with the Calgary-based airline this week after a one-day strike.
title: WestJet cabin crew union reveals details of tentative deal following strike

description: Katie Wadden says what got her rowing crew through the 2026 championship race at the Regatta was the thought of their head coach Mike Power.
title: 'For Mike': 2026 Regatta women’s champions say win was for their late coach

description: Israeli prosecutors Thursday charged a settler for the killing of a Palestinian community leader last year in the occupied West Bank, according to an indictment filed in district court.
title: Prosecutors charge Israeli settler for killing Palestinian activist in West Bank

description: The Israeli military said Thursday that two of its soldiers were killed in an explosion in southern Lebanon in the first Israeli deaths since the implementation of a shaky truce with the Iran-backed Lebanese militant group Hezbollah in June.
title: Israel confirms death of 2 soldiers, striking back in Lebanon

description: Leylah Fernandez fired three aces and connected on five of six break-point opportunities Wednesday to breeze past Mexico's Renata Zarazua 6-2, 6-2 in front of a partisan crowd at Sobeys Stadium. The Laval, Que., native is the lone Canadian remaining in either of the men's or women's draws of the National Bank Open.
title: Canada's Leylah Fernandez moves into 3rd round of National Bank Open

description: Staff at the federal Fisheries Department are worried the United States government is about to adopt legislation jeopardizing the survival of the North Atlantic right whale, according to an internal government memo.
title: Internal DFO memo warns Trump-backed bill threatens right whale survival

description: Allana Swayze expected to pay more in rent after new flooring, lighting and a security system was added to the entrance and hallways of her Winnipeg apartment building — but she never imagined the owners would ask for a 78 per cent increase.
title: Winnipeg tenants fight proposed 78% rent hike after 'mainly cosmetic' building upgrades
Britain's 'exceptionally serious' drought tests a country famous for its rain

description: Cuba saw two nationwide power outages in a span of hours between Sunday and Monday, leaving the island's population once again having to wait for the lights to come back on.
title: More misery for Cubans as power grid fails again amid summertime heat

description: The number of police-involved sexual assault complaints reviewed by the Special Investigations Unit has been declining since 2021, data analyzed by CBC News shows. Researchers say changes to the Ontario police watchdog’s investigative mandate may be behind the decline and advocates warn it could result in fewer people reporting polic
title: Ontario police watchdog no longer investigates most off-duty sex assault complaints

description: Perez Hilton's video has since been taken down, but was there any way to prevent people from witnessing something so traumatic?
title: Perez Hilton livestreamed apparent self-harm. How did TikTok let this happen?

description: After decades of gradual decline, Canada’s peacekeeping tradition is entering its final chapter. The Defence Department is shutting down four overseas missions and shrinking another, arguing troops are needed elsewhere. Critics warn the move sacrifices a defining national identity and surrenders diplomatic influence to countries such as China.
title: Rebalancing or retreat? Canada's peacekeeping legacy fades away

description: So-called friendslop games have sold millions over the last few years thanks to their focus on simple-to-learn scenarios, a lower-than-average cost of entry and a willingness to embrace the chaos that emerges when you get a group of friends together to have some fun.
title: What is friendslop? Inside gaming's fastest-growing trend, including the newest hit Big Walk
